en: The image shows an old photograph of a harbor or waterfront with several boats and ships docked near the shore. In the foreground, there are two people in a small rowboat in the water. The scene is calm, with trees and buildings visible in the background. The colorization and style suggest the image is from the early 20th century. The text 'Sandhamn' appears in the upper right corner.
